missionVision.title: OUR MISSION & VISION
missionVision.missionText: To safeguard lives, property, and business continuity across Bangladesh by delivering internationally certified — UL listed and FM approved — fire safety equipment and engineered protection systems, supported by end-to-end design, installation, testing, and maintenance services of uncompromising quality.
missionVision.visionText: To be the most trusted and preferred fire safety solutions partner in Bangladesh and across South Asia — recognised for engineering excellence, integrity, and round-the-clock responsiveness — where every facility we protect operates with complete confidence in its fire safety readiness.
missionVision.chairmanText: From our very first installation, our resolve has been simple: no facility should ever be at risk for want of reliable fire protection. RN Group was founded on the belief that world-class, UL listed and FM approved fire safety equipment should be within reach of every business in Bangladesh. Today, supported by our parent group and our own state-of-the-art refill plant, we are able to bring you internationally trusted equipment, professional installation, and dependable after-sales service all under one roof. We consider it a privilege to protect your people and your business.
missionVision.chairmanRole: Chairman, RN Group Fire Safety Equipment & Solution
missionVision.ceoText: In an era when fire safety regulations are growing ever more rigorous, we believe that protection begins long before an incident occurs. Our team of certified engineers works with you from design and drawing through installation, testing and commissioning, and continues with regular preventive maintenance so your system is always ready to respond. Whether you operate in the power, commercial, or ready-made garment sector, we commit to serving you with the same technical discipline and care we apply to our largest national projects.

about.title: ABOUT US
about.heading: A FEW WORDS ABOUT US
about.bannerAlt: About RN Group Fire Safety Solutions
about.p1: At 1981 RN GROUP Group started its business as a processor of fruits and vegetables in Bangladesh. Now RN GROUP Group is the leading agricultural and plastic product producer and manufacturer. Beside food and plastic products Rangpur Metal Industries Limited (RMIL) being a sister concern of RN GROUP Group starts importing world class fire safety equipment for serving all over our country. In the beginning the sales, servicing and marketing started under the banner of RN GROUP Fire Safety.
about.p2: RN Group Fire Safety Equipment & Solution as expressed by the name is dedicated to provide quality fire safety products and services. All of the products are imported from various countries of first world which are UL listed and FM approved. We have done a lots of big projects in different Government and Non- government organization. The Span of work also extends to different sectors like power, commercial and RMG industries. Our clients are our advocates and they speak for our quality products and services. Our own refill plant helps us to provide excellent quality refills with accurate measurements for fire extinguisher with high influence of technology. Besides fire safety we provide surveillance system as well.
about.p3: We welcome the opportunity to become your safety partner in your valuable business.
